title: Cpf1 Cloning Protocol
author: Jaclyn Winter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8f4htqw
materials: Cells were harvested and frozen at -80C
Supernatant filtered with an 0.22 micron filter
Cpf1- double gRNA complexed digestion protocol
Ligation can be made with T4 ligase from NEB.

steps.title: Transform E. coli with plasmid
steps.instruction: Transform a protease‑deficient E. coli strain with the plasmid pDEST‑hisMBP‑AsCpf1‑EC using standard heat‑shock or electroporation methods.

steps.title: Grow culture in LB
steps.instruction: Inoculate and grow 2 L of LB medium containing ampicillin (ampicillin used in place of carbamycin) at 37 °C with shaking until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.6.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Ice‑cool the culture, add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.5 mM, then incubate at 16 °C for 14–18 h with shaking.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells by centrifugation, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 50 mL lysis buffer (50 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 200 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl₂, 1 mM DTT, 10 mM imidazole) supplemented with 1 mg mL⁻¹ lysozyme (optional protease inhibitor may be added if available).

steps.title: Lyse cells by sonication
steps.instruction: Sonicate the suspension on ice for 10 min using a Branson sonifier with microtip set to 60 % duty cycle and power level 6.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 20 000 g for 30 min at 4 °C and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Bind to Ni‑NTA
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL Ni‑NTA resin to the cleared lysate and incubate for 4 h at 4 °C with gentle mixing.

steps.title: Wash and elute protein
steps.instruction: Transfer the resin to a column, wash with 100 mL of 2 M NaCl solution, then elute bound protein with 30 mL of 250 mM imidazole buffer.

steps.title: Buffer exchange and concentrate
steps.instruction: Exchange the eluate into lysis buffer lacking MgCl₂ and imidazole (e.g., by desalting column or dialysis) and concentrate the protein to a final volume of 1 mL.

steps.title: Dilute protein stock
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration and dilute the stock to 0.1 µg µL⁻¹ (≈1 U µL⁻¹).

steps.title: Dilute gRNA
steps.instruction: Dilute guide RNA to 300 ng µL⁻¹ in IDTE buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Make 10× restriction buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10× buffer containing 100 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.9, 10 mM MgCl₂, and 1 mM DTT; store at –20 °C for up to one year (≤5 freeze‑thaw cycles) or at 4 °C for up to one week.

steps.title: Make 5× stop solution
steps.instruction: Mix 30 % glycerol, 1.2 % SDS, and 250 mM EDTA to obtain a 5× stop solution; add glycerol last.

steps.title: Run digestion and recover DNA
steps.instruction: Combine Cpf1 protein, gRNA, DNA substrate, 10× restriction buffer, and any other required components; after incubation add 5× stop solution, then purify DNA as for a normal restriction digest—agarose‑gel purify fragments <50 kb, or ethanol‑precipitate larger fragments (column purification shears >50 kb).
